title: at handle register inscription body
description: JSON inscription body only. Plain text @handle needs no JSON. The same bytes in an OP_RETURN, including AT1|reg|…, are not a registration. p must be at — dns and dx bodies are not handles.

op.description: reg is an alias of register. config and primary are different inscriptions.

name.description: @ plus 1..15 characters, or the localpart alone. A character is [a-z0-9_], one Extended_Pictographic scalar, or one flag (two regional indicators). Canonical form adds @ and lowercases ASCII. Count characters, not bytes. A dot, a lone regional indicator, a ZWJ sequence, or a skin tone is invalid.

cname.description: Another @ handle, not a DNS name.

lightning.description: user@host or lnurl1…. A record value, not a second registration.
